The '''Royal Palace of Zygerria''' was the residence to the rulers of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was home to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]].

==Characteristics==
The palace was located on a mesa in the middle of Zygerria's Capital [[City/Legends|city]]. It was quite lavish and well guarded. There we're a series of catacombs and dungeons beneath the palace where [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] were kept.
